# OkToChat

> OkToChat is a free, ad-free chat app for Android and the web, with encrypted private chats, group calls, a feed, an AI assistant called OkAI, games and console apps for the Nintendo DSi, 3DS and Wii.

OkToChat is free, has no ads, no tracking and no subscriptions. Private messages are encrypted on the phone. Minimum age 16. Contact: oktosupport@virgilio.it

## Wiki
- [OkToChat Wiki](https://oktochat.github.io/wiki/): OkToChat is a free, ad-free chat app for Android and the web, with encrypted private chats, group calls, a feed, an AI assistant called OkAI, games and console apps for the Nintendo DSi, 3DS and Wii.
- [OkToChat features](https://oktochat.github.io/wiki/features/): Everything OkToChat can do: encrypted chats, group calls, the feed, OkAI, music, drawing, a built-in browser, tools, games, OkToChat Pass and Plus.
- [OkToChat on Nintendo DSi, 3DS and Wii](https://oktochat.github.io/wiki/consoles/): OkToChat has homebrew apps for the Nintendo DSi, 3DS and Wii, and a DSi game called OkToChat Story.
- [OkToChat FAQ](https://oktochat.github.io/wiki/faq/): Answers to common questions about OkToChat: price, privacy, OkAI, age, games and console apps.
